aboutCompanyText:
E to E Transportation Infrastructure is an ISO 9001:2015 certified company engaged in providing integrated rail engineering solutions across railway mainlines, urban transit systems, and private sidings. With over 15 years of experience, the company works as a system integrator and offer end-to-end services for railway infrastructure projects in India and selected international markets.

Its services cover the complete project lifecycle, including design, consultancy, procurement, installation, testing, system integration, and operations and maintenance. The company specialize in rail signaling and telecommunication systems, railway electrification, and turnkey projects involving civil and track works. Its solutions are customized to meet the specific requirements of each project.

The clients include Zonal Railways, public sector undertakings (PSUs) under Indian Railways, infrastructure development companies, large manufacturers, and corporate entities that own and operate private rail sidings.

The company has successfully executed a wide range of projects such as railway signaling and telecommunication systems, electrification works, track construction, and operations and maintenance for railway and urban transit projects. Some of its key projects include CBTC signaling systems for Hyderabad Metro and Nagpur Metro; signaling and telecommunication modernization for private sidings at Vizag Steel Plant, NUPPL Power Plant, and UPVRNL Harduaganj; Electronic Interlocking system upgrades at Hosur–Salem; siding expansion for Gujarat Pipavav Port Limited with DFCC connectivity; railway electrification and signaling upgrades for the Kadur–Chikmagalur section under Indian Railways’ 100% electrification initiative; and platform screen door installations for Mumbai Metro Line 3 and Chennai Metro Phase 1.

Exim Routes Limited operates as a global marketplace for recyclable paper materials, providing Indian paper mills with a complete suite of services—from sourcing wastepaper to ensuring quality and managing logistics.

The organization functions through a group structure, with Exim Routes Limited registered in India as the parent company and supported by several international subsidiaries.

Positioned as a global recyclables exchange, Exim Routes specializes in enabling cross-border trade in paper and metal scrap. Its proprietary AI-driven B2B platform, ERIS, connects buyers and sellers worldwide, optimizing procurement processes, supply chains, and delivery operations.

The Company’s business model centers on procuring wastepaper from international markets and supplying it to mills in India, while coordinating logistics and trade activities across various regions.

With operations spanning multiple continents, Exim Routes has established strong bases in India and Singapore, and maintains subsidiary entities in the USA, UK, Germany, and South Africa.

Its service offerings cover the full trade cycle, including global sourcing, quality checks, logistics management, and execution of cross-border transactions.

By integrating a wide international network with advanced technology, Exim Routes aims to simplify and modernize the global recyclables trading ecosystem.

aboutCompanyText:
Corona Remedies is an India-focused branded pharmaceutical manufacturer engaged in developing and marketing products in women’s healthcare, cardio-diabeto, pain management, urology and other therapeutic areas. According to the CRISIL Intelligence Report, it is the fastest-growing company among the top 30 firms in the Indian Pharmaceutical Market (IPM) based on domestic sales between MAT June 2024 and MAT June 2025, achieving a CAGR of 13.58% compared with the IPM CAGR of 7.90%.

The company is also identified as the second-fastest-growing among the top 30 IPM companies between MAT June 2022 and MAT June 2025, recording a CAGR of 16.77% versus the IPM CAGR of 9.21%—over 1.82 times higher.

As of June 30, 2025, the company’s portfolio includes 71 brands covering women’s healthcare, cardio-diabeto, pain management, urology and multispecialty therapies such as VMN, gastrointestinal and respiratory care. A nationwide marketing and distribution network, supported by 2,671 medical representatives across 22 states, ensures deep engagement with healthcare professionals and hospitals.

The company operates two manufacturing facilities in Gujarat (Bhayla) and Himachal Pradesh (Solan), and is commissioning a hormone manufacturing facility in Gujarat expected to begin operations in Q1 FY 2027. As of June 30, 2025, the facilities span 2.83 hectares and have an installed capacity of 1,285.44 million formulation units per year across 11 production lines.

Wakefit Innovations Limited, established in 2016, is an Indian Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) brand specializing in home and sleep solutions. The company first rose to prominence with its memory-foam mattresses, which were sold online at competitive prices by removing traditional retail intermediaries.

Since then, Wakefit has broadened its offerings to include a wide range of home products such as pillows, beds, sofas, study desks, wardrobes, and various décor and furnishing items—aiming to meet the lifestyle needs of contemporary Indian households.

The business is largely driven by its digital-first model, supported by efficient logistics and responsive customer service, allowing it to serve customers in both metropolitan and semi-urban regions.

Wakefit’s products are available across 700 districts in 28 states and 6 union territories. As of September 30, 2025, the company operates 125 physical stores across 62 cities in 19 states and 2 union territories.
